coverage.scope: Retained receipts for the fixed service queries; source-data coverage and service health remain unestablished.
limitations: Complete capture means successful receipt retention, not complete telemetry coverage or service health.
Known credential echoes are redacted; unrelated sensitive telemetry is not automatically detected.
Finalization may use up to 2500 ms for observed bytes and metadata; synchronous filesystem I/O cannot forcibly preempt an uninterruptible kernel operation.
This adapter has fixture evidence only; no live Grafana version, rendering, panel transformation or service-health claim is made.
Known credentials are masked in private echoes and observational data; arbitrary sensitive telemetry is not detected. Public request identity and generated controls are preserved.
Requested points/lines do not prove returned coverage. Empty frames are not an all-clear; cancelling a client does not prove remote query cancellation.
The operator environment provider catches accidental retargeting; it does not isolate credentials from the same OS account.
Metric meaning is declared by the installed query; backend semantics and service health are not verified.
Scrape coverage, absent series, sampling, staleness and job-label reuse can limit the observation.
Requested points do not prove returned coverage; empty results are not zero or an all-clear.
